annotation.title_clean: Projeto de Lei n. 842/2024 - Altera a Lei nº 12.965 (Marco Civil da Internet) para dispor sobre a obrigatoriedade de sinalização de conteúdos gerados por inteligência artificial
annotation.title_en: Bill No. 842/2024 - Amends Law No. 12,965 (Brazil's Internet Civil Framework) to require labelling of AI-generated content
annotation.authors_or_issuer: Dep. Ruy Carneiro, Câmara dos Deputados
annotation.summary_en: Brazilian Chamber of Deputies bill amending the Marco Civil da Internet to require internet applications using AI to generate audio or audiovisual content to continuously label it as AI-generated, with consumer-protection penalties for non-compliance. Motivated by deepfake scams.
key_provisions_or_claims: Adds Art. 29-A requiring clear labelling throughout AI-generated audio/audiovisual content
Adds user right to be informed that content was AI-generated (Art. 7, XIV)
Non-compliance treated as consumer-law infringement with Consumer Code penalties plus civil and criminal liability
Labelling via watermark or caption persisting through the entire content
Enters into force 90 days after publication
